semantics.chain_rule: A ? chain explicitly sequences declared q-family/query operations or chain steps.
semantics.intermediate_rule: Intermediate model/backend output is inert data unless the next declared step consumes it.
semantics.command_rule: Intermediate text cannot directly select arbitrary runtime command/root.
semantics.bound_rule: Chain depth/rounds are finite and explicitly bounded.
semantics.failure_rule: Step failure/timeout produces structured chain failure according to explicit continuation policy.
semantics.provenance_rule: Each chain step retains input/output/backend/operation provenance.
semantics.authority_rule: Chaining does not widen permissions across steps.

invariants.rule: Command parsing, namespace resolution and execution remain explicit; namespace grouping never silently becomes executable behavior.
